ValidationRule.description: DEPRECATED - deactivate this - scenarion handled in NSP_ValidateOpportunityStage.cls - When the Opportunity is moving to closed Won, its primary product and Primary Bundle should be in sync with Primary Product and Client for life of its Primary Quote
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.OpportunityTrigger__c ) , ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR( TEXT( NSP_PrimaryProduct__c ) <> TEXT( SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.NSP_Opportunity_Primary_Product__c ), TEXT( NSP_Client_For_Life__c ) <> TEXT( SBQQ__PrimaryQuote__r.NSP_Client_For_Life__c ) ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(NSP_PrimaryProduct__c, "WO")), NOT( OR( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) , $Profile.Name = "Data Migration", $Profile.Name = "Sales Administrator" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please update the Primary Product and Primary Bundle on the opportunity that matches the quote
